name: RuffNeck Learn
purpose: Practical AI literacy, digital skills, productivity and professional learning for founders, freelancers, professionals, teams and organisations.
features: Browse structured courses
Create a free account
Learn at own pace
Practical AI tools for work, business, education and personal productivity
Advanced records and information management
Effective teaching and digital teaching
Advanced AI productivity, automation and prompt engineering
Excel and Power BI data analysis
Digital marketing and AI content creation

steps: Open RuffNeck Learn.
Browse the course library.
Open a course to review its level, subject and description.
Create an account or sign in where required.
Follow the enrolment instructions shown on the course page.
Clarify the learner's goal and current skill level.
Match the goal to a course subject and level.
Explain that course availability and pricing must be confirmed on the live course page.
Direct the learner to the course page for current details.

name: RuffNeck Prospector
purpose: Free multi-platform prospecting and Google intent discovery to help users find customers who need services.
features: Discover leads through Google and DuckDuckGo intent searches
View scored prospects with influence and niche-fit signals
Manage prospects in a pipeline
Generate personalised PDF guides and slide decks
Built-in discovery for digital marketing, websites, AI solutions, graphic design, CV writing and Excel data cleaning
Public-source discovery across Instagram, X, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Google and email workflows, subject to platform access and applicable rules

steps: Open Prospector and sign in if prompted.
Open Discover.
Enter a service niche and relevant search intent.
Review the returned public-source results and their context.
Save suitable prospects and review them in Prospects or Pipeline.
Select an appropriate prospect or campaign context.
Open Generate.
Choose a PDF guide or slide-deck output where available.
Review generated content for accuracy before sending.

name: RuffNeck Connect
purpose: Community, collaboration and action platform for discovering communities, expressing needs, sharing offers and finding collaborators.
features: Discover communities by interests, location, work and goals
Post needs and requests
Share skills, resources, knowledge and time as offers
Find collaborators and build projects
Private purposeful conversations
Record outcomes and contributions

steps: Open RuffNeck Connect.
Choose Get started or sign in.
Explore communities aligned with your interests, location or goals.
Open a relevant community and follow its join instructions.
Open the relevant community or posting area.
Describe the need or contribution clearly.
Include practical details, scope and expected next step.
Publish and respond through the platform's conversation tools.

name: RuffNeck Social Hub
purpose: Social operations workspace for organisations and teams. Workspace data requires authenticated membership.
features: Secure sign-in and organisation workspace access
Social operations across connected brand/client workspaces
Current public landing page provides sign-in and organisation overview entry points

steps: Open RuffNeck Social Hub.
Select sign in.
Use the account associated with the organisation.
If access is denied, ask the organisation administrator to verify membership and role.
Never share passwords, access tokens or one-time codes with support agents.

limitations: Do not promise a specific social network integration, publishing capability, plan, quota or feature unless confirmed in the customer's live workspace or current product documentation.

name: Kano Run / Kano Life
purpose: Browser-based Kano State keke driving and life simulation entertainment experience.
features: Kano setting and Adaidaita Sahu keke driving
Routes, drivers and modes
Passenger pickup and drop-off, fares, fuel and vehicle condition
Garage customisation and daily login rewards
Career, time attack, fuel challenge, match drop, potholes and free roam modes
People, relationships, life and career simulation panels
Keyboard and touch controls

steps: Open Kano Run.
Choose a route, driver and mode.
Select Start Driving.
Use A/D or arrow keys, or swipe to change lanes.
Use gas and brake controls; slow almost completely at pickup and drop-off pads.
Use the garage, daily reward and life/career panels from the game menu.
Pause the game and check the selected rendering mode.
Check browser compatibility and available device memory.
Reload the game if a session becomes unresponsive.
Report the device, browser, game mode and exact issue if it persists.

name: Kano Keke
purpose: 3D keke driver life simulator set around Kano routes.
features: Select a driver
Select a Kano route
Select a keke
Select a road
Select a game mode
Tutorial selection
Daily reward
Start shift
Garajin Keke Shop customisation options including neon underglow, subwoofer and steel bumper as displayed on the current public page

steps: Open Kano Keke.
Select a driver, Kano route, keke, road and mode.
Review the tutorial selection if needed.
Claim the daily reward if available.
Select Start Shift.

limitations: Treat visible shop prices and inventory as live display values; recheck in-game before quoting because they may change.
